cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a starship data archive — standing; an indoor surf-wave practice pool with turquoise water — she takes a cheerful break from balancing practice; a neighbourhood grocery or convenience store with bright aisles — standing close to a high shelf or line; a present-day museum gallery of Three Kingdoms relics — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a bright glass-roofed intercity tram moving through a coastal city — she balances a small paper bag of freshly roasted chestnuts on her lap; a mountain lodge with a front counter and a fireplace — standing; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — checks the photo on the back screen of a camera at chest height; a mirrored labyrinth of endless reflections and soft coloured light — holds a folding fan open near her chest; an open-air hot spring among steaming rocks — dries her hair with a towel; her tower bedchamber in a stone castle — standing; the rail of a harbour ferry deck in the wind — standing with one foot up on a step; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — carries a camera by its grip at her side; an ice palace hall of carved crystal pillars — standing
